caption:
Claude just turned your phone into a remote for AI.

Claude Dispatch lets you text full tasks from anywhere.
Build a 15-slide deck while in a cab. Clean your inbox on a flight. Process CSVs at dinner.
You send once. Pick up later. Everything’s done.

The Channels feature even auto-fixes GitHub bugs at 3 AM before your team wakes up.
AI just went from a tool you use to a worker you manage.

I share many of these AI updates daily in my free WhatsApp community.
